_comment: Ja Nach word bank. word = exact noun guessers type; modifier = optional absurd prompt extension shown to drawer only; aliases = legitimate alternate spellings/names >1 edit away from `word`, accepted at FULL points (closer slips are caught automatically by the Levenshtein matcher); typos = common spelling MISTAKES, also accepted but always counted as a `close` hit so they earn reduced points. Mix target: ~25% Bangladeshi-context (food/places/icons/daily life) + ~75% universal. Visual draw potential > vocabulary breadth — heavy on animals, food, daily objects.
